_swall11_render_basis: 1.21.11 render-backend records and counters on 26.1's (javap of both): SubmitNodeStorage.BlockModelSubmit (model + one tint colour -> parts with seed 42 + a colour per tint index; accessors from what the constructor got, rt/CbWallBlockSubmits), BlockBreakingRenderState(level, pos, progress) -> 26.1's record of pos, level.getBlockState(pos), progress, SectionRenderDispatcher.getToUpload() -> the sections staged for upload in 26.1's uber buffers (rt/CbWallSectionUploadCount), CompileTask.doTask's future <-> 26.1's result (rt/CbWallCompileTasks), SubmitNodeStorage.BlockSubmit (gone with submitBlock) -> facade/BlockSubmit and SubmitNodeCollection.getBlockSubmits() -> the blocks submitBlock queued this frame, adding one queues its model (rt/CbWallBlockSubmits, rt/CbFapiSubmitBlocks)

overrideHooks.basis: 1.21.11's CompileTask.doTask(buffers) answered a future of the result (completed after the section's uploads); 26.1's compiles, stages and answers the result: a 1.21.11 subclass's future, joined (CbWallCompileTasks)

adapterHooks.basis: 26.1's SectionRenderDispatcher has no getToUpload(); a 1.21.11 dispatcher subclass's own override is what 1.21.11's callers got (CbWallSectionUploadCount.getToUpload)
26.1's SubmitNodeCollection has no getBlockSubmits(); a 1.21.11 collection subclass's own override is what 1.21.11's callers got (CbWallBlockSubmits.blockSubmits)
